---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that switchyard does not support well today?

## Proposed solution

How should it work? Include a config example if it adds or changes options.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, or workarounds you use at the moment.

## Scope

Switchyard deliberately leaves out TLS termination, service discovery, rate limiting and a dynamic admin API. If this touches one of those, explain why it belongs here.
